name: @pragmatic-tech-ai/pragmatic-configuration-runtime
description: What a hive component reads at start: the applied-configuration object (pragmatic-config-<component>), the runtime reader, and the start step that overlays the applied configuration onto the process environment (secrets as memory-backed files). Depends on pragmatic-component only, so a lean container (hive agent, gateway, UI unpacker) can carry it.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build
